name: Christoffer Heckman
title: Associate Professor; Jacques I. Pankove Faculty Fellow; Faculty Director for Artificial Intelligence
fitReason: Direct match to physically grounded 3D/embodied vision: diffusion geometry is integrated into an actual robot exploration stack, with complementary foundation-model belief calibration. A short CS project could address observed-versus-generated geometry, uncertainty or robust spatial semantics.

physicalEvidence.summary: SceneSense is integrated with GBPlanner on an actual Boston Dynamics Spot, with physical hallway traversal and exploration tests. The full journal article specifies off-board GPU inference, so this is not an entirely onboard edge system. Locally enhanced maps improve traversal; the frontier-based full-exploration variant sometimes fails. The paper was published December 29, 2025, despite its 2026 volume. A separate May 2026 belief-consistency paper evaluates KITTI-360/ScanNet with dataset poses; it is not a new closed-loop robot deployment.

shortVisit.summary: Current official profile, ARPG and personal homepage verify the host and contact but do not provide an explicit external visiting-student or summer invitation. Technical consulting availability and degree recruitment are not research-visit pathways.

scoreReasons.fit: 39/40: strong learned3D perception, generative mapping and uncertainty-aware embodied semantics.
scoreReasons.physical: 25/25: specific current-institution physical Spot exploration experiments, with off-board computation and failure caveats.
scoreReasons.freshness: 15/15: substantive May 2026 semantic-mapping methods paper; physical SceneSense article remains explicitly 2025.
